# AI Use Disclaimer

## v0.2.0

* **Rust/cargo**: Core logic is human-coded. AI assisted with comment paraphrasing, procedural macros implementations (`ahoi-stock-macro`, `ahoi-rets-macro`), and test generation.

* **JS/npm**: SolidJS is human-coded. Packages for other frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte) are generated by AI based on the SolidJS'.

* **Playgrounds & Book**: Human designed, AI-implemented.

* All AI-implemented tests and examples are human-reviewed.
